other_failure_modes.name: Improper OneHotEncoder configuration
other_failure_modes.description: Using `drop='first'` alongside `handle_unknown='ignore'` in OneHotEncoder causes unknown categories in the test set to be encoded as all zeros. Since the first category is also implicitly encoded as all zeros, the model cannot distinguish between a genuinely unknown category and the first category of the training set, potentially skewing predictions.

other_failure_modes.name: Arbitrary ID generation for test set
other_failure_modes.description: The agent generates a sequential ID column for the test predictions using `range(len(predictions))` instead of preserving the actual identifier column from the test dataset. If the test set IDs are not simply 0 to N-1, the predictions will be misaligned with the ground truth.

other_failure_modes.name: Using identifier columns as features
other_failure_modes.description: The agent includes all columns except the target as features, without filtering out identifiers or metadata columns. This can cause the model to overfit on arbitrary indices and reduces generalisation.
